pages.text: Give the trigger block a redstone pulse, for example with a button. The program runs on its sheet in the c0de dimension. While it runs, a PID block and a cursor sit on the cursor rail.

When it is done, the output inventory holds a variable item. Take it out and right-click while holding it. The dialog shows the name $(1)result$(), the type INTEGER and the value 42.$(br2)Congratulations, you wrote your first c0de program!
